lines.zh: 我拖着斧子走过岩浆边。
lines.en: I drag my axe past the lava.

lines.zh: 盔甲破了，露出底下的皮。
lines.en: My armor is broken; hide shows through.

lines.zh: 我走得很沉，像背着一座山。
lines.en: I trudge as if carrying a mountain.
Gold trim glints in the firelight.
I skirt a lava fall.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩在石头上，哒哒响。
lines.en: My hooves click on the stone.
I shake the ash off my axe.

lines.zh: 我的脚步把碎砖踩得更碎。
lines.en: My steps grind the rubble finer.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，挡开火星。
lines.en: I raise a hand against the sparks.
I stand, my axe propped on the ground.
An old wound crosses my chest.
I press it with a finger.
I press the old wound. It still hurts.
I stand. There's no wind in the Nether.
I push my helmet down.
I push my helmet down. My ears listen.
All quiet but the lava bubbling.
I spit.
It hits the stone and smokes.
I tug the broken strap.

lines.zh: 甲带断了半截，我拽了拽，无人过问。
lines.en: A strap is broken. I tug it. Nobody cares.
No one comes. I keep standing.
My legs have gone numb.
I shift my stance.
The haft warms in my grip.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼睛在盔影里。
lines.en: I lift my head, eyes shadowed by the helmet.
I size up your gear.

lines.zh: 我上下扫了你一眼，比我强。
lines.en: I look you over. Better gear than mine.
Better than mine. I spit.
I spit, and you step back.

lines.zh: 你退了小半步，我咧嘴笑。
lines.en: You step back and I grin.
My teeth are pointed.

lines.zh: 我咧嘴露出尖牙，斧子提起来。
lines.en: I bare my pointed teeth and lift the axe.
I raise the axe, then lower it.
I lower it. Not yet.
Standing there is asking to die.
I grunted once, and stayed up.
The armor cracks again.

lines.zh: 我后撤半步，把重心压稳。
lines.en: Half a step back, weight set.
Blood runs from the old wound.
I prop myself on the haft.

lines.zh: 我拄着斧柄站稳，挨得不轻。
lines.en: Braced on the haft, and it hurt.

lines.zh: 血吐在地上，人还立得住。
lines.en: Blood on the ground, and I'm still up.
I don't intend to die here.

lines.zh: 这地方我不打算咽气，上。
lines.en: I'm not dying here. Come on.
Is that gold in your hand?
Gold? I don't eat gold.
Is that pork in your hand?

lines.zh: 那手里要是猪肉，倒还说得过去。
lines.en: If that's pork in your hand, that'll do.
That'll do. Throw it over.
It comes over. I catch it.
Gone in a blink. More.
More? Don't come closer.
I'll bite the hand too.
You hit my armor and recoil.

lines.zh: 你撞在我盔甲上，我晃都没晃。
lines.en: You hit my armor. I don't even sway.
Broken armor, but still hard.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我看见了你的力气。
lines.en: That showed me your strength.

lines.zh: 这一下试出你的斤两，还差得远。
lines.en: That showed your weight. Not nearly enough.
Not much. You back off.

lines.zh: 这一撞之后你退了，很好。
lines.en: After that bump you backed off. Good.
I lean in a step and walk on.
I keep walking. Don't block the path.
Piglin remnants don't bother with that.
All we have left is one breath.
I glance at it sidelong.
I glance, and its eyes meet mine.
Then we fight.
Afterward we part.
That's our way.

lines.zh: 打完就散，从来只有这一条规矩。
lines.en: Fight, then part. That's the only rule.
I shoulder the axe again.

lines.zh: 斧子甩回肩上，我接着往前。
lines.en: The axe goes back on my shoulder. Onward.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块带火星的石头。
lines.en: I pick up a stone still trailing sparks.
I stoop and come up with gold.
In my hand, I bite it.
One bite. It's genuine.
It's real. I tuck it at my belt.
Though there's no one to trade with.

lines.zh: 也没人跟我换，先揣着吧。
lines.en: No one to trade with. Keep it.
I switch the axe to my other hand.

lines.zh: 斧子重新压回我的肩头。
lines.en: The axe settles back on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我把斧子换到左手，你动了。
lines.en: I switch the axe to my left hand. You moved.
I heave the axe up.

lines.zh: 蹄子刨了两下，我选定你了。
lines.en: My hooves paw twice. I've chosen you.
This is the Nether. Don't think about running.

lines.zh: 这地方没处可逃，别费劲了。
lines.en: There's nowhere to run here. Don't bother.
This is the Nether. Nowhere to run.
I slap the ash off my armor.
That shield won't stop a gold sword.

lines.zh: 灰从甲缝里抖落，我开始数。
lines.en: Ash falls from the seams as I start counting.
The blade comes up. One.
The blade toward you. Two.
I step in. Three.
The count is done. Here I come.

lines.zh: 别逼我跑起来，追上就更难收手。
lines.en: Don't make me run. I'm worse when I catch up.
I get meaner when I have to chase.
Don't make me chase. Stand firm.
I want to see you block once.

lines.zh: 让我见识见识你的格挡，一次就够。
lines.en: Show me your guard. Just once.
Then we'll talk.
Toward the dead end, you run fast.

lines.zh: 你脚程很快，我懒得去追。
lines.en: You're quick. I won't bother chasing.
I don't chase. I walk straight.
This way's blocked. You'll double back.

lines.zh: 我早就知道，这里是死路。
lines.en: I've known a while. This is a dead end.

lines.zh: 这条路通不到别处，我清楚得很。
lines.en: This road goes nowhere. I know it well.

lines.zh: 你早晚兜回来，我在拐角守着。
lines.en: You'll loop back. I'll hold the corner.

lines.zh: 斧刃垂着，在石上刮出沟。
lines.en: The axe hangs low, gouging the stone.
My heart beats steady.
Your breathing’s gone uneven.

lines.zh: 斧刃刮地的声响让你回头。
lines.en: The axe scraping stone makes you turn.

lines.zh: 你回头看了，我就在那儿。
lines.en: You look back, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我走了一步，你加快脚步。
lines.en: I take a step, and you speed up.

lines.zh: 你脚下加速，间距却不动。
lines.en: You speed up. The gap doesn't change.

lines.zh: 间距没缩短，可我一步没落。
lines.en: The gap holds, and I never drop back.
The door ahead is shut.

lines.zh: 前头那道门合上了，你听见了。
lines.en: That door ahead shut. You heard it.

lines.zh: 你也听见了，我听得更清楚。
lines.en: You heard it. I heard it clearer.
The door is shut. Then so be it.
My axe comes down.
A deep scar stays in the stone.
I shove your shield aside with my shoulder.
The haft catches your chest.
The impact knocks you back.
You fall back. I'm panting.
The wound has opened again.

lines.zh: 我用牙咬住斧子，换个手。
lines.en: I hold the axe in my teeth and switch hands.

lines.zh: 旧伤崩开了，我照样再砍一记。
lines.en: The old wound splits. I swing again.
Another swing, and you block it.
My grip splits open.
Blood drips onto the haft.

lines.zh: 这一斧被你挡下，身手不赖。
lines.en: You turned that axe. Not bad.

lines.zh: 掌心的口子裂开，接着砍。
lines.en: My palm splits. Swing again.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆的影子里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the shadow of the lava.

lines.zh: 盔甲掉了一块，挂在那儿。
lines.en: A piece of armor hangs loose.

lines.zh: 我把斧子从地上拔起来。
lines.en: I pull my axe from the ground.
The Nether is just the same.

lines.zh: 站起来一看，没有猪灵城。
lines.en: On my feet: no bastion.

lines.zh: 看不见猪灵堡，也看不见同伙。
lines.en: No bastion. No comrades.

lines.zh: 同伙都没了，只剩我一个。
lines.en: No comrades. Only me.
I pull my gold sword out of the rubble.

lines.zh: 灰拍干净了，伤口仍往外渗。
lines.en: Ash brushed off, the wound still weeps.
But I don't plan on lying down.

lines.zh: 我没打算就这么躺下去，于是抬头。
lines.en: I don't mean to lie down. I raise my head.
I smell something alive.

lines.zh: 活人的气味飘过来，远得很。
lines.en: The smell of the living, far away.
Far off. I walk that way.
The axe drags behind me.
Sparks all along the way.

lines.zh: 火星洒了一路，我慢慢走。
lines.en: Sparks trail behind me. I take my time.
There's not much left anyway.

lines.zh: 反正没多少可留，动身吧。
lines.en: Little left to keep. Let's go.
Fire catches me and my hide curls.
I hit the ground and the armor scatters.

lines.zh: 水在这里罕见，我呛住了。
lines.en: Water is rare here. It chokes me.
The blast throws me into the rock.

lines.zh: 光缠住我，斧子抬不起来。
lines.en: Light binds me and the axe won't lift.
No food, and hunger shakes my hands.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的盔上，火星乱跳。
lines.en: Lightning hits my helmet and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，火光在上面变小。
lines.en: I fall as the fire shrinks above.
